# BearSSL, vendored

Upstream: https://www.bearssl.org/git/BearSSL, commit
`7bea48e5e850ab4cafbe68d3765cdaba13a86d6f` (2026-04-06).  Only `inc/`, `src/`,
`LICENSE.txt` (MIT) and `README.txt` are copied, unmodified.

It is built by `memento-hello/web/bearssl.mk`, which says which sources are
left out and with which settings, for the Web window's TLS.
